notes.title: ✨ New Update Available! ✨
notes.content:
We’ve added a brand-new Roguelike Mode in the Extras menu!
Now you can:

-Play quick and challenging runs with dozens of unique cards.
-Practice your strategies without pressure.
-Earn golden stamps to use in the main game.

A fresh way to enjoy, experiment, and spend time inside Lost Letter!

notes.title: Mega Update – Twice the Content! 🌟
notes.content:
[h2][b]BIGGEST UPDATE[/b]
[/h2][p]- [b]World Expansion[/b][/p][list][*][p]Now featuring [b]113 countries to explore[/b] – more than double the previous version![/p][/*][*][p]Over [b]1300 unique stamps[/b] to collect, discover, and combine.[/p][/*][/list][p]- [b]60 Brand-New Achievements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Test your skills and collection mastery with sixty achievements to unlock.[/p][/*][*][p]From beginner milestones to ultimate challenges, there’s always something new to strive for.[/p][/*][/list][p]- [b]Stamps Like Never Before[/b][/p][list][*][p]Brand new [b]stamp types[/b], levels, and synergies to create powerful combos.[/p][/*][*][p]Rare, mystical stamp textures to make your collection shine.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Booster packs[/b] containing extremely strong new stamps.[/p][/*][/list][p]- [b]Transports & Interface[/b][/p][list][*][p]A brand-new [b]visual transport interface[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]HUD overhaul with a slick 3D-style effect (without going full 3D).[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Transport Insurance[/b] to make your travels easier.[/p][/*][/list][p]- [b]The Litte Market[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fresh collectible content.[/p][/*][*][p]Stamp duplication options.[/p][/*][*][p]Passport to unlock new countries and side quests.[/p][/*][/list][p]- [b]Reworked Challenge Mode[/b][/p][p]The [b]Challenge Mode[/b] has been completely redesigned!
Inspired by [i]Balatro[/i], you now face the [b]Consulate[/b], which requires you to hit certain scores to progress.[/p][list][*][p]Earn the new currency: [b]Golden Stamps[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Unlock unique and super powerful stamps.[/p][/*][*][p]A strategic, satisfying challenge for true collectors![/p][/*][/list][p]-A lot of bugs fixed.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]This update marks a new era for the game, [b]doubling its content[/b] and introducing exciting systems for both veterans and new players.[/p][p][/p][p]Are you ready to collect, travel, and face the Consulate? ✈️ [/p]

notes.title: Update: Rebuildable Stamps Fixes & New Features!
notes.content:
Hello stamp explorers!
A new update is here with important bug fixes and a stylish new feature:

[b]🔧 Fixes[/b]
Fixed bugs related to rebuildable stamps, which could affect progression in reconstruction.

Corrected texts, translations, and some stamp images for better clarity and immersion.

[b]New: Hide Stamps on Letters[/b]
You can now hide stamps on your letters by right-clicking on them!

Want to keep your letter clean or mysterious? Just right-click on a stamp to hide it.

To show it again, go to the stamp collection menu and right-click the specific stamp again.

[i]*Note:[/i]
Hiding a stamp does NOT remove its points — it’s purely visual! Just for fun and style ✨

👉 Give it a try and see how your letters can look even better!

🏆 Coming Next: Achievements!
In the next update, we’ll be adding achievements to unlock as you play.
Stay tuned and keep collecting!

— The dev team 💌
